scope: Primary-source operational facts; independent clinical/pharmacy approval pending

indication.text: HER2-positive advanced/metastatic breast cancer with progression after prior therapy including anthracyclines, taxanes and trastuzumab in the metastatic setting. ECOG0–2. This is not a first-line or adjuvant regimen.

schedule.text: Each cycle21days: lapatinib1250mg once daily continuously Days1–21; capecitabine1000mg/m² twice daily Days1–14, then no capecitabine Days15–21. Continue until progression/unacceptable toxicity. The capecitabine break does not stop lapatinib.

food.text: Capecitabine with food or within30minutes after food; swallow whole with plenty of water, do not crush/cut. Lapatinib at least60minutes before or after food. NCCP says antacids/H2 antagonists/PPIs not within2hours of lapatinib; this must be accompanied by pharmacy review because the current EMA SmPC generally advises avoiding medicines that raise gastric pH, so timing separation alone does not resolve a PPI interaction. Missed/vomited lapatinib doses are not replaced; resume next scheduled dose.

baseline.text: FBC, renal/liver profile; DPD genotype/phenotype before first capecitabine unless already tested. NCCP TESTS lists ECG+echo/MUGA if clinically indicated, but its cardiac-complications section explicitly requires cardiac function including LVEF for ALL patients before lapatinib and recommends considering ECG/QT before and during treatment. Reconcile this internally: baseline LVEF/echo plus ECG/QT/risk review, citing p7/SmPC rather than claiming p2 alone makes all testing mandatory. Renal impairment can falsely elevate uracil DPD phenotyping; consider genotype assessment.

ongoing.text: FBC, renal/liver profile before each21daycycle. Echo/MUGA every12weeks, approximately before cycle5 then9 if uninterrupted;4–8weekly if cardiac impairment. ECG if clinically indicated/QT risk or symptoms. LFTs monthly or as indicated: the21dayprecycle blood schedule meets this minimum. Assess hands/feet. Response imaging according to individual consultant plan; NCCP does not prescribe blanket3monthlyCT. Current EMA Tyverb SmPC4.4 requires ECG with QT before starting and1–2weeks after initiation (cycle1Days8–15), then when clinically indicated, including after interacting medicines. Correct K/Mg before treatment. This specific timing is an EMA addition to the NCCP schedule.

support.text: Both agents minimal-to-low emetogenic risk; usual premedication not needed. Individual PRN antiemetic/interaction review. Diarrhoea plan and hand-foot skin care; NCCP loperamide example4mg at first onset then2mg after each loose stool, maximum16mg/day or local policy. Early/severe diarrhoea/dehydration, chest symptoms, severe rash/blisters, jaundice or breathing symptoms prompt clinical contact. Do not merely treat severe diarrhoea through ongoing dosing.

logistics.text: Both medicines oral at home; no routine infusion chair, pump, pump disconnection or line insertion for this regimen. Prescribed tablet calendar and pharmacist meal schedule distinguish continuous lapatinib from capecitabine14on/7off. Bloods and clinical review before the next cycle; actual prescriptions/restarts are clinician confirmed. Separate oral handling, adherence, interaction/OTC/supplement check, contact plan and supply review.

indication.text: HER2-positive metastatic/locally recurrent unresectable breast cancer without prior anti-HER2 therapy or chemotherapy for metastatic disease. ECOG0–2; baseline LVEF≥50%; ANC baseline exclusion<1.0. Do not copy Phesgo docetaxel ECOG0–1/ANC1.5 thresholds.

schedule.text: Day1 every21days: initial IV pertuzumab840mg, trastuzumab8mg/kg, docetaxel75mg/m²; subsequent420mg,6mg/kg,75mg/m². Docetaxel may be escalated to100mg/m² if tolerated by consultant. Source table minimum6cycles, with cessation for toxicity or after6–8cycles if responding and no progression; both antibodies can continue. Treatment is not a fixed one-year adjuvant course.

baseline.text: FBC, renal/liver profile and LVEF echo/MUGA.

ongoing.text: FBC/renal/liver before each21daycycle. Echo/MUGA every12weeks during trastuzumab and at treatment completion;4–8weekly when cardiac impairment. First routine12weekcheck around cycle5. Maintenance does not reset the cardiac clock. Response imaging individual treatment plan; no exact mandated CT interval.

support.text: Docetaxel low emetic risk; antibodies minimal. Docetaxel dexamethasone8mg PO twice daily for3days starting day before each dose; minimum3doses before treatment unless contraindicated. Missed oral premed: consultant may consider20mg IV immediately before chemo, not an automatic substitution. Consider primary G-CSF. Antibody premedication not usually required absent prior hypersensitivity; consider paracetamol/antihistamine per history/local policy. After docetaxel ends, remove routine taxane dexamethasone and chemotherapy support unless another indication.

logistics.text: Separate IV antibodies plus IV docetaxel; no combined Phesgo thigh injection. First pertuzumab60minuteinfusion then1hourobservation; trastuzumab90minuteinfusion with source observation≥6hours from start of first and≥2hours from start later doses, subject documented local policy; docetaxel60minutes after antibodies. Subsequent antibody infusions usually30minutes, pertuzumab30–60minuteobservation, source permits no pertuzumab observation after3consecutive tolerated treatments. Long first visit; do not imply cumulative total duration by adding all observation intervals because local sequencing/overlap matters. Peripheral cannula or agreed central access; not mandatory port/pump.

indication.text: HER2-positive metastatic/locally recurrent unresectable breast cancer without prior metastatic anti-HER2/chemotherapy; weekly paclitaxel only when docetaxel unsuitable, not tolerated or significant toxicity. ECOG0–1, LVEF≥50%, baselineANC≥1.5.

schedule.text: Every21days, IV pertuzumab+trastuzumab Day1 (same loading/maintenance as00204), paclitaxel80mg/m² IV Days1,8,15 for up to8cycles. Both antibodies may continue after paclitaxel stopped for toxicity or after6–8cycles if no progression. Days8and15 are paclitaxel-only; maintenance visits are Day1 every21days.

baseline.text: FBC, renal/liver profile and LVEF echo/MUGA.

ongoing.text: NCCP specifies FBC/renal/liver before each CYCLE, not explicitly weekly. Each weekly dose still needs clinical/tolerance assessment; timing of extra pre-dose bloods is agreed locally and must not be falsely attributed to NCCP. Echo/MUGA every12weeks and at completion;4–8weeks if impairment. Neuropathy assessment as indicated. Imaging consultant plan; not universal3monthlyCT.

support.text: Paclitaxel low emetic risk, antibodies minimal. First paclitaxel dose dexamethasone8mgIV+chlorphenamine10mgIV+famotidine20mgIV30minutes before. Day8andlater no routine dexamethasone unless reaction/risk under consultant guidance; chlorphenamine10mgIV and famotidine20mgIV30minutes before. Famotidine omission possible under consultant guidance, acknowledging uncertain reaction risk. Do not duplicate steroid antiemetics. Consider analgesia for myalgia/arthralgia; G-CSF after febrile neutropenia per source. Maintenance requires no routine paclitaxel premedication.

logistics.text: IV antibody loading/observation as00204; paclitaxel60minuteinfusion on each weekly day with nonPVC set and0.22µmfilter. First/Day1 visit longer than Days8or15; no Phesgo injection or pump. Central line only if individually chosen.
